description: MCP server for Zuuna — agent-native board access for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_add_checklist_item
tool_signatures.description: Add a checklist item to a card (appended at the end).

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_archive_card
tool_signatures.description: Archive a card (reversible — see zuuna_unarchive_card).

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_board
tool_signatures.description: Get one board assembled: its columns (in order, with WIP limits and SLA hours) and its cards (key, title, column, priority, type). The card list pages at 200; when more cards exist the response carries cardsTruncated and a nextCursor — pass that back as cardsCursor for the next page. Accepts the board id, its key (card prefix) or its title.

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_boards
tool_signatures.description: List the workspace

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_card
tool_signatures.description: Get a card

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_comment
tool_signatures.description: Add a comment to a card. The author is the user who created the API token. @mentions notify.

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_create_board
tool_signatures.description: Create an empty board (no columns yet — add them with zuuna_create_column) in a group. Body: title, groupId.

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_create_card
tool_signatures.description: Create a card on a board. Title is required; give the target column by id or by title (omitted = the board

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_create_cards
tool_signatures.description: Create up to 50 cards on ONE board in a single call. Each item validates exactly like zuuna_create_card (title required; target column by id only) and the answer is one result per item: created (id, key, title, status, columnId) or the error that item alone would have gotten. The card cap counts the whole batch; board, closed-sprint and limit errors stay whole-request.

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_create_column
tool_signatures.description: Add a column to an existing (non-archived) board.

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_delete_attachment
tool_signatures.description: Remove an attachment from a card. Requires confirm: true.

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_delete_card
tool_signatures.description: Move a card to Trash (restorable for 30 days via zuuna_restore_card, then permanently purged). Refused with time_entries_exist if the card carries logged time, UNLESS confirm is true — passing confirm also acknowledges deleting those hours. Requires confirm: true.

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_delete_checklist_item
tool_signatures.description: Remove a checklist item. Requires confirm: true.

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_get_attachment
tool_signatures.description: Get one attachment

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_list_attachments
tool_signatures.description: List a card

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_list_automations
tool_signatures.description: Read a board

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_list_board_cards
tool_signatures.description: List a board

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_list_board_fields
tool_signatures.description: Read the custom fields attached to a board: id, name, type, in display order. For SELECT, MULTISELECT and TAGS fields, options is the option vocabulary a card

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_list_checklist
tool_signatures.description: Read a card

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_list_columns
tool_signatures.description: List a board

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_list_comments
tool_signatures.description: Read a card

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_move_card
tool_signatures.description: Move a card to another column on the SAME board. Give the target column by id or by title (resolved against the card

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_move_card_to_board
tool_signatures.description: Move a card to a DIFFERENT board (cross-board move). Optional targetColumnId; omitted, the card lands in the target

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_restore_card
tool_signatures.description: Pull a card back out of Trash. Refused if the workspace is at its card limit (an archived+trashed card is exempt).

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_search_cards
tool_signatures.description: Search cards workspace-wide: the one list that needs no board or group id up front. Filters narrow: q (case-insensitive text in title + description), groupId, boardId, columnId, assigneeId, epicId, priority (HIGHEST|HIGH|NORMAL|LOW|LOWEST), label (a tag option id or \

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_unarchive_card
tool_signatures.description: Restore an archived card to active (the inverse of zuuna_archive_card). Refused if the workspace is at its card limit.

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_update_card
tool_signatures.description: Edit a card. Only the fields you send change: title, description, priority, type, dueDate, startDate, estimateSeconds, storyPoints, ready, columnId (move within the SAME board — a cross-board move is zuuna_move_card_to_board), assigneeIds (REPLACES the full set; [] clears everyone), customFields (object keyed by field id; null/empty clears one — zuuna_list_board_fields names the ids and the option vocabulary).

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_update_checklist_item
tool_signatures.description: Rename and/or tick a checklist item. Only the fields you send change.

tool_signatures.name: zuuna_upload_attachment
tool_signatures.description: Upload a file onto a card from a local file path, or from base64 plus a filename. The same limits the REST upload route enforces apply and its errors surface verbatim: 10 MB per file, the workspace storage cap (409 limit_reached), executable extensions refused, and the token creator needs a verified email.
